title: context-atoms v1 composition
description: A context composition assembling context atoms into a complete context definition consumable by an agent runtime. Supports two composition styles: (1) atom-bundle style using the 'references' object for situational-frame, environment-descriptor, conversation-scope, working-memory-shape, and attention-budget refs; (2) session-context style using identity_ref, channel_refs, and active_policies for olympus/aish runtime sessions.

identity_ref.description: Reference to the identity atom for the principal that owns this session (session-context style). Format: identity-atoms/identity/<slug> or a short slug such as 'service', 'developer', 'security-architect'.

channel_refs.description: List of channel atom slugs or refs available in this session (session-context style). Each entry is a channel slug (e.g. 'http-webhook', 'stdio', 'ollama-chat') or a full atom ref.

active_policies.description: List of policy atom slugs or refs enforced for this session (session-context style). Evaluated in list order; first matching rule wins.
